posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
Sooo, I thought I'd post this here and see if anyone was interested. Someone I know from another forum has been making his own game (with the help of some other people, including myself) over the course of the past...erm, couple of years I think, maybe. Anyway, it's been out in Alpha form for ages and has finally made it onto Steam. People who pre-ordered (or helped in the development in some way) got three Steam keys as a reward. I've used one myself and given the second to Ja'Ph', which means I have a third one going spare.

The game in question is called Dwelvers. The developer, a guy called Rasmus, put it together as a homage to both the Dungeon Keeper and Settlers games - you're the master of a dungeon, you get your imps to dig out tiles so you can build rooms. You recruit creatures and have to provide stuff like food, beer, and gold to keep them happy so they don't rebel while you train them up and explore further, digging out dungeons inhabited by "wild" creatures and portals to the surface guarded by knights and stuff. The Settlers part comes in because you can set up production chains and stuff to make sure all the stuff you need gets, well, produced :).

If anyone is interested, just say so here and in the event that more than one person is interested, whoever gets there first will get the key. Because how else do I decide whom to give it to? ;)
